High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee errata card [[Run Luke, Run! (PC Errata)]] (the earlier errata image marked "E"), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. strangewayes re-set the card for printing, so small details (fonts, colours, the gold "E" errata mark, some icons) differ from the Holotable image; the wording is that of this version.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Run Luke Run _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1p5rmur0trAGTRiqTmlm6b7vtZi34pLic/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Run Luke Run _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,300 bytes, SHA-256 <code>0a841dc99f3842553629b00aea98e14298235357511f750bbb57be2fc5d69e86</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article is [[:File:P2P-L-runlukerun-E-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
